x: Edward's effort was a very fine one; and Chamberlain's running, which took him into third place, is full of promise, and shows that we have yet another junior of more than average ability.
Chamberlain in his first open race, finished 38th, an excellent performance, but was running for our "B" team, and so of course could not count for our "A" team.
We have, of course, three members of last year's winning team still available, and backed up by Wood, Chamberlain, Quackenbos, Merryman and Pointer, they can scarcely fail to do well.
220 Yards : 1 Chamberlain (Poly), 2 Osmint (Bel.), 3 Archer (Poly). 25 secs. 440 Yards : 1 Higgins (H.H.H.), 2 Betterton (Bel.), 3 Heathfield (Bel.). 53 secs.

Chamberlain was 2nd in the Long Jump with 19ft. 1½inches only losing by ½ an inch. On May 2nd a few of our athletes were engaged at the Leyton Flood Light meeting and it was pleasing to have Ivan Mayers running so well over the 100 yards in really first class company to finish 4th in 10.1secs.
